dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eh? There's another one of you...

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: Ah, you must've met my elder sister downstairs, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: We're twins, and most people can't tell us apart by appearance. We sound very different, though, so we get exposed the moment we open our mouths.

dialogues.speaker: Argalia
dialogues.text: My sister speaks slow, but she's a careful sort. If you need help on the first floor of the restaurant, just leave it to her.
